# ggTrader Strategy Research Snapshot

> **Engine note (2026-11-06):** every number dated before 2026-11-06 in this file was computed on the legacy engine (vectorbt 0.28.5, pandas 2.3.3, git tag `legacy-engine-vbt0285`) and has not been re-run on vectorbt 1.2.0; the registry now holds 10 ported strategies and 28 legacy-only ones (`research/programme/vectorbt-engine/P5c-completion.md`).

**Regenerated by:** `.claude/skills/research-snapshot`
**Last full regeneration:** 2026-11-20 (source of truth: `main` at `77ef2932`)
**Last incremental update:** 2026-11-24: three dead-stock rows (first test, data integrity and payout evidence, payout rerun), one methods bullet and one gap; the baseline, the registry and both research prompts were not regenerated and do not mention these studies.
**Previous full regeneration:** 2026-11-05. The one-row r9 edit of 2026-11-20 is folded into this run.
**Scope:** Research verdicts and model limitations; live operations remain frozen. The paper trader has been stopped since 2026-11-06 and cron stays off until the owner says otherwise; nothing described here is deployed.

This full regeneration re-surveyed the registry (10 registered strategies plus 28 legacy-only
names, 38 in all), every dated report added or newly covered since 2026-11-05 (the eight stock screens
and the expected-growth input pilot of 2026-11-10/11, the verdict register and its review notes,
the strategy-categories report, the corrected-membership notes, the benchmark and objective notes,
the paper-system notes, the intraday r8 and observer reports that the previous roster lacked, and the r9 result), the deployed construction in code and the
candidates backlog. Baseline numbers did not move: the replica, SPY and cross-asset figures are the
2026-10-19 values, and the corrected S&P 500 list moves only the engine reference run (core17 Sharpe
0.3905 to 0.3958), which the owner kept on vintage 1. What did move: none of eight published-portfolio
stock screens met both preset thresholds (expected investment growth met the recent-return threshold only), the paper path changed in code (still
undeployed), and the owner retired GO/NO-GO labels for new work, so new rows below state
"threshold met / not met" with the evidence. Older verdict text stays as history.
Historical verdicts remain historical evidence: old gate counts are not valid DSR
validation, and old price-tape results are not silently upgraded into clean reruns.
Both research prompt templates were regenerated with this snapshot on 2026-11-20.
[Root-cause executive summary](audits/root-cause-2026-11-04/2026-11-05-executive-summary.md);
[research guide](programme/RESEARCH_GUIDE.md) (the current starting point for open questions);
[verdict register](VERDICT_REGISTER.md) (incomplete: identified 269, included 139, pending 2,
excluded 128 at its 2026-11-10 cutoff).

## 1. Current validated baseline

**SPY buy-and-hold remains the comparator.** The specified fixed-default stock
model plus SPY sweep is **NO-GO** (2026-10-19 verdict, kept as history). The primary replay earned 14.19% CAGR versus
SPY's 14.83%, excess −0.64 percentage points/year, Newey-West t −0.69. Its Sharpe
0.925 versus 0.903 and drawdown −21.44% versus −24.50% do not pass the registered
return/significance bars. Mean exposure was 9.37% stocks, 85.33% SPY and 5.30%
cash. Source: [production-rule audit](audits/production-replica/2026-10-19-production-replica-audit-nogo.md),
[_production_replica_results.json](audits/production-replica/_production_replica_results.json),
`windows.primary.arms.primary.{stats,spy_stats,excess_vs_spy,mean_exposure}`; the figures were re-checked
against the JSON on 2026-11-10 in the [claim verification](programme/benchmark-objectives/2026-11-10-claim-verification.md) (items 1 and 2).
The root-cause investigation (accepted 2026-11-05) rates this result inconclusive
against its own +1.0 pp/yr bar: at whole-account level it could detect about 4.2 pp/yr,
if PARA (a ticker whose stored prices belong to a different security for its whole S&P 500 membership) proves immaterial. The recorded NO-GO is unchanged.
[Executive summary](audits/root-cause-2026-11-04/2026-11-05-executive-summary.md).
The replica's retained outputs hold daily aggregate weights only, not a fill ledger or per-symbol positions, so a self-financing
"same dates, SPY instead of the stock sleeve" attribution is unresolved
([artifact inventory](programme/benchmark-objectives/2026-11-10-replica-attribution-artifact-inventory.md)).

This is a **historical daily-bar model**, not a measured reconstruction of the
live path. Exact historical live parity is **UNVERIFIED**: 10/32 orders matched
(31.25%); manual actions, the old lookback and missing original decision inputs
are disclosed without changing the denominator. The older-window holdout is
**INCONCLUSIVE**: 87.39% price coverage passes, but 11 unique trades match flagged
artifacts. Its performance is non-citable. Model NO-GO is authorized by the
[approved closure amendment](audits/production-replica/2026-10-19-production-replica-closure-amendment.md);
the raw driver's stopped verdict is retained. Sources: parity JSON
`explained_orders/strategy_orders/explained_pct`; replica JSON `closure`,
`windows.holdout.mean_coverage`, `.arms.primary.tainted_trades`, `verdict`.

**The SP500 core reference run on the Rust engine (vectorbt 1.2.0).** The 17-fold ensemble WFO (core17, membership vintage 1,
frozen tape of 2026-11-06, OOS 2022-01-31 to 2026-04-29) gives OOS Sharpe **0.3905**, CAGR **3.50%**, max drawdown −9.58%, gates
1/17, anchor deployed in 17/17 folds, against SPY on the same window 0.7792 / 13.02% / −22.09%
([run record](programme/membership-database/evidence/db1__p5_core17_ensemble_sp500.json): `diagnostics.oos_metrics`,
`diagnostics.spy_metrics`, `gates`, `anchor_folds`; [P5 completion note](programme/vectorbt-engine/P5-completion.md)
table row core17). The legacy-engine figure for the same run was 0.592 / 3.08% / −5.28% with gates 17/17 (pre-guard, pre-DSR-fix gate
count void; [S5 spec](programme/vectorbt-engine/reports/2026-11-06-spec-S5-validation-protocol.md) line 98). The DSR-threshold-0 diagnostic is 0.6374 / 3.41%, gates 17/17, anchor 0/17.
The corrected S&P 500 membership list (vintages 2 and 3) moves only core17, to Sharpe **0.3958** and CAGR **3.56%** (gates unchanged at 1/17);
dsr0 is unchanged to 14 decimals, and the live-signal replay matches on 27 of 120 sessions on the corrected list versus 120 of 120 on vintage 1.
**The owner kept every reference run on vintage 1 and did not re-baseline** ([evidence note](programme/membership-database/2026-11-08-reference-numbers-on-corrected-membership.md)).
Cite 0.3905 / 3.50% as the reference and 0.3958 / 3.56% only as a corrected-list sensitivity. In all of these the standalone core trails SPY by a wide margin.

The historical standalone WFO core on the legacy engine (0.59 Sharpe, 3.1% CAGR versus SPY 0.78,
13.0%) selected parameters and sized entries as a percentage of remaining cash.
The former KEEP construction's 0.80 versus SPY 0.78 also used those selected
parameters and same-close fills. Neither is the live fixed-default portfolio.
Sources: [PIT rebaseline](audits/rebaseline/2026-09-23-pit-rebaseline-core-nogo.md),
[KEEP scope correction](allocation/core-spy-blend/2026-09-24-core-spy-blend-keep.md). Different benchmark
Sharpes reflect different OOS spans and data vintages; do not compare them as
identical-window replications.

A future stock candidate is judged under the owner-approved forward-paper standard:
Part A needs a long free-history test with Holm-corrected t of at least 3 and at least
+1.0 percentage point a year net since 1994. B0 is a kill-only replay, B1 a forward
shadow book of at least 18 months, and real money needs six months of clean paper
trading first. A sleeve is judged by SPY plus sleeve against SPY alone, funded out of
SPY. The standard received a one-character transcription fix on 2026-11-11 (the quarterly stop is `≤ −0.15`, not `< −0.15`; no new gate).
Source: [standard](programme/evidence-standard/2026-10-23-forward-paper-standard.md),
[next steps](../docs/next_steps.md). **GO/NO-GO labels are retired for new work** (owner, [research guide](programme/RESEARCH_GUIDE.md), "Decisions"):
a new result reports the evidence, whether each preset threshold was met, and the uncertainty; the action decision is the owner's.

Two separate allocation decisions remain distinct from stock alpha:

- **Cross-asset static 80/20: shadow-only GO under its own bar**, not a proven
  selection edge. Pinned Sharpe 0.973 versus SPY 0.896, CAGR 13.61% versus 14.70%,
  drawdown −21.26% versus −24.50%; the historical stress holdout passed weakly.
  Gold dependence, uncertainty and T-bill-excess comparisons limit the result.
  [Report](allocation/cross-asset-sleeve/2026-09-28-cross-asset-sleeve.md);
  `_cross_asset_sleeve_results.json`, `primary:pinned.1bp.static`,
  `primary:pinned.bh.SPY`, `verdict`; `_cross_asset_sleeve_holdout_results.json`.
  The 2026-11-10 shadow decision brief records the governing shadow rule, qualifying observations and clock as **UNRESOLVED**; the owner
  on 2026-11-11 chose this 80/20 book for the future parity scope and a three-month mechanics review followed by a 12-month performance review
  (no start date, no thresholds, nothing authorized). [Brief](programme/verdict-framework/2026-11-10-cross-asset-shadow-decision-brief.md).
- **A23 70/30 SPY/SSO: owner allocation choice**, not a Sharpe-based lab GO.
  Historical after-tax CAGR 12.00% versus SPY 10.40%; the original higher-funding
  sensitivity reduces that margin to +0.80 point/year, below its +1.0 bar.
  A24 timing rider is NO-GO. The ordinary-distribution bound reduces the
  higher-funding margin to **+0.77 point/year** at 24/15 (11.17% versus 10.40%);
  owner annual-review and rebalance terms remain unchanged.
  [A23/A24 report](allocation/static-leverage/2026-09-30-static-fractional-leverage.md),
  `_static_leverage_aftertax_results.json`, `_static_leverage_aftertax_rf_plus0.025.json`
  and `_static_leverage_aftertax_dist_bounds.json`,
  `windows.main_real_sso['static 1.3x (70/30) band 8pp']['24/15']` versus
  `['SPY buy-and-hold']['24/15']`.

One descriptive protection comparison (already-seen window, pretax, 2021-04-30 to 2026-04-30, month-end rebalance, 1 bp a trade) is on record. Per $100,000:
80% SPY / 20% TLT-GLD-PDBC ended at $180,680 (12.56% a year, worst drawdown −21.35%, 2022 return −15.59%); 80% SPY / 20% BIL $170,234 (11.23%, −19.77%, −14.23%);
100% SPY $184,371 (13.02%, −24.50%, −18.18%). One hindsight-selected episode, not a verdict; the owner chose 80% SPY / 20% Treasury bills as the
next protection comparison, with boundaries, bill instrument and acceptable wealth sacrifice still open and the draft not approved for a study.
[Descriptive comparison](programme/verdict-framework/2026-11-10-protection-measures-explained.md) (section "Descriptive historical comparison"),
[return and protection assessment](programme/verdict-framework/2026-11-10-return-and-protection-assessment.md).

Current production documentation specifies a capped stock sleeve, portfolio-value
sizing and SPY sweep; the former roughly thirty-name mismatch was addressed by
missed-exit catch-up and the position cap. It is no longer an unexplained current
exposure claim. The freeze and owner's future decision remain in force.
Sources: [next steps](../docs/next_steps.md), [warm-up study](paper-system/indicator-warmup/2026-09-28-live-indicator-warmup.md),
commit `fe5c4a7`; replica audit scope limitations.

Deployed construction, re-read from code on 2026-11-20: each stock entry is sized at 3.3%
of portfolio value (`RiskConfig.position_pct`, `src/ggTrader/paper/risk.py:19`, applied in `position_notional`, `src/ggTrader/paper/risk.py:85-87`) and
stock names are capped by `MAX_POSITIONS` (code default 30 at `src/ggTrader/paper/risk.py:18`, overridden by the
environment at `risk.py:26-28`; the comment at `risk.py:9-10` says live sets 3, about 10% of the book in stocks; the live value sits in `.env`, which this run did not read).
Idle cash is swept into SPY once it exceeds 8% of portfolio value, down to a 5% reserve
(defaults `src/ggTrader/paper/cash_sweep.py:38-41`, logic at `cash_sweep.py:112-116`;
default OFF, enabled by `CASH_SWEEP_ENABLED`, `cash_sweep.py:11` and `:32`; each default can be overridden by the environment).
The lab equity default sizes entries at 3% of remaining cash (`SIGNAL_POSITION_SIZE` in
`STOCK_BASE_CONFIG`, `src/ggTrader/lab/data.py:36`, read at `src/ggTrader/engine/portfolio.py:210` and applied with vectorbt
`size_type="percent"` at `src/ggTrader/engine/portfolio.py:236`; the fallback at
`src/ggTrader/engine/portfolio.py:48` is 2%). The replica (now `research/audits/production-replica/code/replica.py`; the old
`lab/simulate.py` and `lab/replica.py` no longer exist) models
portfolio-value sizing, a position cap of 3 (`replica.py:39`), catch-up exits and catastrophe stops
(`ReplicaConfig`, `replica.py:35-45`). The Telegram total-P&L message now shows two reference bases (`1c7a3138`).
**The paper path did change after 2026-10-19** (the earlier claim of "no change" is withdrawn). Since 2026-11-06 (`git log d1846e6e..HEAD -- src/ggTrader/paper`; the list names the behavior changes, not every commit):
a fail-closed S&P 500 membership gate for live runs that reads the latest database vintage only (`befd8742`, `5e6d2bc8`, `86a5de85`);
interrupted-order recovery and a stop when pending-order state is unavailable (`8b418248`, `783c7267`), then durable order intents (`47d8a3c9`);
an exits-only halt policy (under a valid loss halt, buys and the sweep stay blocked while eligible exits for other holdings proceed;
design note [unresolved-order exit design](paper-system/observation-readiness/2026-11-11-unresolved-order-exit-design.md); approved by the owner 2026-11-12 per
[next steps](../docs/next_steps.md), merged `efa1aea1`, **not deployed**) in `47d8a3c9`, with invalid-portfolio-value halts in `RiskGuard` (`risk.py:43-69`, same commit);
a conservative halt for known unapplied splits in place of the first add-back fix (`f3d39310`, `c66b18e0`; the false one-day halt of buys is an accepted trade-off per [where we left it](../docs/where-we-left-it-2026-11-12.md));
and the Phase 5 split of `PaperTrader._run` into step objects, behavior-preserving by design (`648074c2` and the merge `77ef2932`; [changelog 2026-11-20](../docs/changelog.md)).
The branch history also holds about 40 further paper commits from refactor phases 3 to 4 (typed records, the `PaperLedger` protocol, `TraderConfig`: for example `bba278ca`, `faa06ca3`, `c1777d91`) and small fixes (`4d94e015` buy-concentration boundary, `ea1a762f` removal of the untradable-skip branch, `550c2342` malformed weights, `c7e85f64` a read-only trader refuses a direct order); none is deployed. `f3d39310` also made an invalid exit quantity block the sweep buy.
`src/ggTrader/lab/strategies/` changed only by the engine rebuild (`27fff069`), a helper removal (`990df359`) and `acb4eac5` (intraday stop and time-stop inputs).

Gap to SPY at 18.3 bps, low tax (worst / middle / best): 2005–2019 -7.2 / -4.6 / -2.0 (first test -16.4 to -2.0); 2020–2024 -0.9 / +0.4 / +1.6 (first test -7.3 to +1.6). The best case is unchanged by construction; the narrower range comes from the 0.0 assumption. Risk is worse than SPY in every cell | [Report](stock-signals/dead-stock-payout-rerun/2026-11-24-dead-stock-payout-rerun.md) |

## 3. What worked, structurally

- **Measure the specified portfolio.** Fixed-default replay, prior-bar signals,
  costs, cash accrual and production sizing replace a selected-parameter proxy.
  Exact live input reconstruction remains a separate, unresolved question.
  [Replica audit](audits/production-replica/2026-10-19-production-replica-audit-nogo.md).
- **Correct statistical units before trusting gates.** Commit `09f9f40` corrects
  annual versus daily Sharpe and the kurtosis term in the Deflated Sharpe Ratio
  (DSR). Past gate counts cannot be cited as DSR validation. With one-year training
  folds and a 12-combo grid, the corrected gate needs an in-sample Sharpe of
  roughly 2.5 to pass, so walk-forward out-of-sample (OOS) results are mostly
  per-fold anchor results. Gate rejections stand; low pass counts reflect low
  power, not proof of no edge. [Changelog](../docs/changelog.md),
  [Retest brief §4](stock-signals/momentum/2026-10-20-momentum-retest.md).
- **Timing tests can falsify assumptions.** `7320c1d` fixes inclusion of returns
  earned before an entry close. The original failing test and owner-approved
  amendment remain documented. [Timing amendment](audits/production-replica/2026-10-19-production-replica-fomc-timing-amendment.md).
- **Pin windows, keep raw artifacts and preserve stops.** A stopped holdout was
  not relabeled clean; a separate owner-approved negative closure is explicit.
  Missing prices and correct security identity are different data questions.
- **Bias corrections remain necessary:** expanding anchors (`2eafab1`), daily PIT
  masks in signal WFO (`c9d1abe`), and timezone/duplicate repairs. Those fixes do
  not prove all remaining vendor history correct. [Anchor fix](audits/rebaseline/2026-08-18-wfo-anchor-leakage-fix.md),
  [PIT report](audits/rebaseline/2026-09-23-pit-rebaseline-core-nogo.md).
- **Benchmark the alternative being displaced.** Include static instruments,
  SPY, funding-leg returns, T-bill excess, costs and tax where applicable.
  [A10](allocation/month-end-treasury/2026-09-24-month-end-treasury-sleeve-nogo.md),
  [cross-asset](allocation/cross-asset-sleeve/2026-09-28-cross-asset-sleeve.md), [A23](allocation/static-leverage/2026-09-30-static-fractional-leverage.md).
- **Attribute walk-forward folds before reading OOS.** Saved fold records split into
  gate failure, gates passed but anchor deployed, and winner deployed. The momentum
  and dual-momentum replays deployed the anchor in 17/17 folds and the FOMC run in
  47/53, so those results evaluate the gate-plus-fallback policy, not parameter
  selection. The Rust-engine core17 reference run also deployed the anchor in 17/17 folds. [Fold attribution](programme/wfo-methods/2026-11-02-wfo-fold-attribution.md).
- **Grade a past verdict by trust before reading its number.** The root-cause
  investigation sorted 72 measured tests by data cleanliness, code check, recomputed
  number and power. Zero came out reliable, so a closed NO-GO there is a verdict on
  the test, not proof of no edge. The verdict register (2026-11-10) carries the same grading per record. [Executive summary](audits/root-cause-2026-11-04/2026-11-05-executive-summary.md),
  [register](VERDICT_REGISTER.md).
- **Add research-machinery changes as opt-in with defaults unchanged**, pin current
  behavior with characterization tests, and preregister synthetic checks of decision
  rules before running them. [Semantics](programme/wfo-methods/2026-11-02-wfo-fallback-semantics.md),
  [synthetic study](programme/wfo-methods/2026-11-02-wfo-policy-synthetic.md).
- **Report evidence, threshold status and uncertainty, not a label.** For new work the
  owner retired GO/NO-GO. Each of the 2026-11-10/11 screens states the comparator (not SPY), the assumed
  cost, whether each preset bar was met, an independent recomputation by a different model family, and
  what it does not show (taxes, fills, revised data, small-company exposure). The category report adds approximate
  bands and says plainly that they are not adjusted for trying eight screens.
  [Research guide](programme/RESEARCH_GUIDE.md), [category report](programme/research-summary/2026-11-12-strategy-categories-alpha-range.md).
- **When a result depends on an unmeasured input, say so first and bracket it.** The dead-stock first test could not know what dead stocks paid; it reported three fixed readings, and the follow-up studies replaced the guess with SEC filing evidence only where a filing supports it, kept the assumption labelled, and let a reproduction check (nobody pinned equals the first test to the cent) stop the run before publishing. [Rerun report](stock-signals/dead-stock-payout-rerun/2026-11-24-dead-stock-payout-rerun.md).
- **Keep the S&P 500 membership list as versioned data and say which vintage a number used.** Three vintages are
  in the database; reference runs stay on vintage 1 and corrections are recorded as notes, not re-baselines;
  the live gate fails closed. [Corrected-membership note](programme/membership-database/2026-11-08-reference-numbers-on-corrected-membership.md).

## 4. What failed, grouped by cause

- **Unvalidated single-stock incremental return.** Ensemble variants added
  complexity without reliable gains; fixed-default stocks plus sweep fail the
  return and significance bars. On the Rust engine the SP500 core reference run (0.3905 Sharpe, 3.50% CAGR) trails SPY (0.7792, 13.02%). [PIT](audits/rebaseline/2026-09-23-pit-rebaseline-core-nogo.md), [audit](audits/production-replica/2026-10-19-production-replica-audit-nogo.md),
  [P5 note](programme/vectorbt-engine/P5-completion.md).
- **Momentum fails the registered evidence and modern-return bars.** The short
  replay's economic gain did not establish significance. The century-long
  French screen rejects neither size under Holm and both fail the
  post-publication economic bar. No parameter or cost rescue is authorized.
  [Audit](audits/production-replica/2026-10-19-production-replica-audit-nogo.md),
  [Phase 1 report](stock-signals/momentum/2026-10-20-momentum-french-screen-nogo.md).
- **Classic stock factors fail significance and modern return bars.** Across 63
  years of survivorship-free French data, all four primary hypotheses fail Holm
  A1 (best NW t 1.34 vs 3.40 hurdle) and all fail post-1994 economic persistence
  A2 (Value, Investment and Combo trail the market net of costs; Profitability
  at +0.83 pt/yr misses the +1.0 pt/yr bar). No paid data.
  [Factor report](stock-signals/factor-screen/2026-10-21-factor-screen-nogo.md).
- **Published-portfolio screens are portfolio results, not stock lists, and none clears both bars (2026-11-10/11).**
  Of eight further screens none meets both t ≥ 3 and +1 pt/yr since 1994; the nearest, expected investment growth, meets only the recent-return
  threshold (+2.63 pt/yr since 1994) with t 2.728 and an assumed 1% cost (t 4.17 with none). The accounting score and R&D screens show high full-window averages that come from earlier
  decades (accounting score −1.09 pt/yr since 1994; R&D −1.82% a year over 2016–2025) with 74% to 79% month-end drawdowns. Monthly reversal and low variance trail in both windows.
  Equal-weighted portfolios with small-company exposure, revised provider data, a market comparator that is not SPY, and no Holm correction across eight tries
  limit every one. Turning a lead into stocks needs dated identities, market values, filing-availability times and at least 30 prior monthly fits that the free sources checked do not yet supply.
  [Category report](programme/research-summary/2026-11-12-strategy-categories-alpha-range.md), [input pilot](stock-signals/feasibility/2026-11-11-expected-growth-stock-input-pilot.md).
- **Calendar and intraday effects consumed by costs or the funding leg.** FOMC fails net;
  month-end duration fails funded out of SPY. The SPY last-half-hour rule (r9, 2026-11-15) lost before costs and costs were about three quarters of the loss:
  −1.46 bp a day after 1 bp a side, NW t −3.48, −3.7% a year after the illustrative tax ledger. Any intraday SPY idea must clear about 2 bp a round trip on every trade. [Audit](audits/production-replica/2026-10-19-production-replica-audit-nogo.md), [A10](allocation/month-end-treasury/2026-09-24-month-end-treasury-sleeve-nogo.md),
  [r9 result](intraday/spy-momentum-feasibility/2026-11-15-intraday-half-hour-rule-result.md).
- **Timing complexity, financing and taxes.** Leveraged rotation/trend and A24
  lose to simpler alternatives; A23 is extra equity risk, not selection alpha.
  [A23/A24](allocation/static-leverage/2026-09-30-static-fractional-leverage.md), [trend report](allocation/leveraged-trend/2026-07-16-leveraged-trend-following-nogo.md).
- **Correlated equity diversification.** Multiple equity universes and familiar
  cross-sectional signals did not establish a useful independent sleeve.
  [MAX](stock-signals/max-effect/2026-07-17-max-effect-nogo.md), [anchor reproduction](audits/rebaseline/2026-08-19-anchor-fix-reproduction.md).
- **Tests that cannot tell a small effect from zero.** The built design is about
  85% SPY and 9% stocks, so it cannot stray far from SPY. At sleeve level the
  replica sees only an excess above about 45 pp/yr, so stock picking stays
  undecided. Only 2x leverage (exposure, not skill) and pre-1994 momentum reached their window's gap (against SPY, or the French market index for the long history). An illustration in the benchmark synthesis needs about 31.4 independent
  years to detect a 1-point annual edge at 2% tracking error under simplifying assumptions. [Executive summary](audits/root-cause-2026-11-04/2026-11-05-executive-summary.md),
  [benchmarks synthesis](programme/benchmark-objectives/2026-11-10-objectives-benchmarks-consolidated.md).
- **Data and history limits.** Event-date joins, index leakage, reused symbols,
  sparse histories and absent PIT fundamentals can dominate plausible signals.
  Earlier failures on a shifted tape do not mathematically prove a corrected
  rerun must be worse. Historical closures are retained with caveats, not
  invented modern confirmations. Recent examples: the corrected S&P 500 list rewrote 10 historical entries (a 2023 rebalance placed two months early);
  13 current members had missing or stale price bars until the 2026-11-09 backfill; the series under `P` is Everpure/Pure Storage, not Pandora;
  SKYD and VMRK carry PSKY's and EQR's histories. [Implementation audit](audits/implementation/2026-07-25-strategy-implementation-audit.md), [audit](audits/production-replica/2026-10-19-production-replica-audit-nogo.md),
  [press-release checks](programme/membership-database/2026-11-09-open-checks-closed-with-press-releases.md).

## 5. Known gaps and limitations

**Event-data feasibility (2026-10-23):** dated historical identity/price mapping,
annual A6 coverage and missingness, complete insider inventories/public-time
reconstruction, source-bound detector screening, and PEAD release/actual/consensus
lineage remain unverified. Public paid-data documentation does not close all
requirements over a common window. The registered canonical audit is unfinished;
the [decision memo](audits/event-timing/2026-10-23-event-timing-audit-decision.md) records the owner decision
to park both studies without paid data. The separate timestamp amendment remains a draft
and needs no decision while the studies are parked.

- **Stock-level inputs for the one screen lead are missing.** Dated identities (incl. delisted names), point-in-time market values, filing-availability times, fiscal-period alignment and at least 30 prior monthly fits are
  not established; the Nasdaq-derived archive's modeling rights are unresolved and the permission request is an unsent draft. Ticker identity differs across sources (`META` versus `FB`). [Pilot](stock-signals/feasibility/2026-11-11-expected-growth-stock-input-pilot.md).
- **Published-portfolio screens share limits.** Comparator is the French or provider market (not SPY), costs are assumed (1% and a 2% stress), results are pretax, the provider's 2026 reconstruction uses revised data,
  related ideas were seen before each screen, no independent timestamp witness exists, and no Holm correction spans the family. The research guide says no category has proven alpha.
- **The paper window has no qualifying start.** The paper account's AVB holding is frozen by the broker (untradable) after AvalonBay's merger closed on 2026-08-17 (the surviving company's ticker is VMRK, formerly EQR); it blocks a clean future observation window by owner decision (2026-11-11). The AVB broker inquiry is an unsent draft.
  The earlier "earliest review about 2026-12-29" date is withdrawn: the qualifying start and any reset are unresolved and a calendar date does not lift the freeze. The shadow rule, start and reset conditions for the 80/20 cross-asset book are unresolved, and the current tracker overwrites its CSV and does not keep a decision ledger.
  [Readiness](paper-system/observation-readiness/2026-11-02-paper-freeze-readiness.md), [shadow brief](programme/verdict-framework/2026-11-10-cross-asset-shadow-decision-brief.md).
- **Paper-trader changes are merged but undeployed.** The membership gate, order recovery, exits-only halt policy, invalid-value halts, conservative split halt and the Phase 5 refactor are on `main`; nothing is deployed and the trader is stopped (next steps, 2026-11-12). Broker behavior (a complete open-order check) still needs verification before any restart;
  an unapplied split can still cause a false one-day halt of buys. The live trader's clock check treats an error as market open. [Exit design](paper-system/observation-readiness/2026-11-11-unresolved-order-exit-design.md),
  [changelog](../docs/changelog.md).
- **The intraday observer has no external alert.** Hermes supervision has been paused since 2026-11-06 09:18 Pacific with no recorded reason; the slot-20 checkpoint on 2026-11-30 needs manual daily health checks. Records, not a performance result. [Activation record](intraday/spy-momentum-prospective-observer/2026-10-27-intraday-observer-activation.md).
- **Exact historical live parity unresolved.** Same-session/retained partial
  bars and absent immutable decision inputs prevent reconstruction of ALL/ARES.
  The lag-0 diagnostic is not that reconstruction. [Parity amendment](audits/production-replica/2026-10-19-production-replica-parity-amendment.md).
- **The historical stock tape is not certified.** TIE/MEE/CPWR identity concerns,
  missing fresh delisted comparisons, held-through artifacts and missing-price
  gaps limit the detector. The stopped holdout supplies no performance evidence.
  [Closure amendment](audits/production-replica/2026-10-19-production-replica-closure-amendment.md).
- **Daily and monthly membership conventions differ.** WFO uses daily PIT entry
  masking. The fixed-rule replica follows monthly as-of eligibility plans. Both
  use historical membership sources; neither implies a fresh live universe.
  Reference runs stay on membership vintage 1; vintages 2 and 3 exist and give core17 0.3958. [Audit](audits/production-replica/2026-10-19-production-replica-audit-nogo.md), `research/audits/production-replica/code/replica.py`, `src/ggTrader/lab/wfo/`.
- **Historical claims have limited portability.** Pre-PIT/tape-fix reports and
  old DSR counts are not current validations. FOMC and momentum are now rerun;
  other dated event studies retain their original limitations. The blend's
  pinned-window drop cannot be blamed on eval-end drift alone; attribution to
  the earlier harness fixes remains inferred. [Correction](audits/rebaseline/2026-08-19-anchor-fix-reproduction.md).
- **Some legacy variants lack dedicated modern reports.** Tournament,
  conviction variants and individual voters have weaker evidence than their
  shipped/registered status suggests. Registry membership is not a GO. Most legacy-only names are not re-run on the Rust engine.
- **The verdict register is incomplete and the roadmap lags.** The register states its own coverage is incomplete and its rows are not independent tests. `docs/roadmap.md` is hand-maintained and was last edited 2026-11-12;
  its old headline benchmarks must not override this record. Both prompt templates
  were regenerated with this snapshot on 2026-11-20. The prompt-kit review's five suggested checks are not yet in the implementation template (awaiting the owner).
- **Live halt base and tested configuration.** The saved account value includes a
  dividend accrual the broker never paid, so the daily-loss halt fires at about 2.7%
  real loss, not 3%; and live runs no tested configuration. Both are recorded, not
  fixed (decision 6 default: no live change).
  [Findings](audits/root-cause-2026-11-04/findings/2026-11-05-findings-plain-english.md).
- **WFO verdicts need fold attribution.** Where most folds deployed the anchor,
  OOS Sharpe measures the gate/fallback policy. Intended semantics for winner-versus-anchor
  WFE, NaN WFE and the halt state are owner decisions (opt-in `WfoPolicy` exists, default
  legacy); the synthetic study's rates depend on its assumed per-fold noise.
  [Semantics](programme/wfo-methods/2026-11-02-wfo-fallback-semantics.md), [attribution](programme/wfo-methods/2026-11-02-wfo-fold-attribution.md).
- **Time exits and price stops on daily bars are approximations.** `td_stop` is keyed to entry signals, and installed vectorbt 1.2.0 has no native Rust duration stop; intraday stops use daily OHLC with assumed slippage and a caller-supplied halt mask that cannot prove complete halt coverage. [Research guide](programme/RESEARCH_GUIDE.md).
- **Taxable accounting library is unvalidated.** `TaxLotBook` implements the lot rules
  with hand-checked tests but has not been checked against a real broker ledger, and
  study-level B0/B1 controls (decision receipts, outside-holdings reconciliation) do
  not exist. [Requirements and status](paper-system/tax-lots/2026-11-02-after-tax-lot-engine-requirements.md).
- **SSO distribution character is partly known.** The fund's May 31, 2026 report classifies its trust-year (ended 2025-10-31) $49,935,027 of distributions as ordinary income, which
  shows the century study's zero-distribution assumption does not match actual payouts; the qualified-dividend fraction, the owner's calendar-year character and the effect on the after-tax results are not quantified.
  SSO expenses: 0.88% before and 0.84% after a 0.04% waiver, 0.95% cap through 2027-09-30 per the 2026-09-28 summary prospectus. [Readiness](paper-system/observation-readiness/2026-11-02-paper-freeze-readiness.md).
- **Closure scope is ambiguous for factor variants.** The factor report's "alternate
  factor definitions" is undefined, so valuation, quality and q-factor variants stay
  `undetermined`; seven of eight reviewed rows are in that state. The owner's ruling on the wording is open ([working task list](../docs/working_task_list.md)).
  [Family-scope review](stock-signals/feasibility/2026-11-02-family-scope-review.md).
- **Root-cause investigation (accepted 2026-11-05) left these open.** No
  cause's share of the shortfall was measured, and none of the 29 Optional Re-run
  List items was run, so their questions stay "unknown, re-run not run". On
  2026-11-04 an agent ran a script only to read its help text and it rewrote prices
  for 19 symbols (at most 27,579 rows). PARA's figures in two check reports can no
  longer be reproduced, and the owner left the symbols as they are. The paper
  shortfall since 2026-06-24 (3.76 pp at run-time broker value, 4.57 on end-of-day
  equity, in total not per year) is attributed by judgement, not measured.
  [Executive summary](audits/root-cause-2026-11-04/2026-11-05-executive-summary.md).
- **Dead-stock payouts are assumed, not measured (2026-11-24).** The 103 stocks with an acquisition-type filing are sold at their last price by assumption; 38 of the 141 held dead stocks have no figure. Jazz Pharma and Sprint Nextel look like name or legal-form changes rather than deaths and are not handled. Both windows used by the dead-stock studies were already seen, and the data file ends 2024-12-31. [Rerun report](stock-signals/dead-stock-payout-rerun/2026-11-24-dead-stock-payout-rerun.md).
- **Operational freeze unchanged.** No loader guard, input archive, stock-sleeve
  retirement or allocation change was deployed by this research. Any future
  action is the owner's separate decision. [Next steps](../docs/next_steps.md).

## 6. Internally-derived candidate ideas

**What changed this run (2026-11-20, full):** the eight 2026-11-10/11 screens, the expected-growth input pilot, the verdict register and the category report arrived; the intraday r9 score is in
(neither threshold met). The leading research question is now the research guide's "reconstruct individual-stock inputs using information available at each decision date";
the previous idea 3 (forward attribution under the shadow rules) is folded into the new idea 1 because no shadow window has started, and idea 2 (distribution-character evidence) was partly advanced by the 2026-11-11 SSO fund report.
All ideas are executable now with free data, long-only and at 1.0x, and none is authorization to implement, test or deploy. The paper trader stays stopped.

*Carried from 2026-11-05:* the root-cause investigation was accepted and four 2026-11-01/02 documents joined the roster; the ranked ideas were security-identity validation, A23 distribution-character evidence,
forward attribution under the shadow rules, settling WFO fallback semantics (owner decision) and validating `TaxLotBook`. Any sleeve is evaluated against its funding leg and the current SPY benchmark with a pre-registered bar.

1. **Make the paper evidence record auditable before any restart question (reliability).** Draft the per-session evidence record that the readiness note proposes (deployed image and configuration, signal inputs and
   their availability, positions and working orders before and after, durable intents, broker acknowledgments, hashes) and decide the AVB/VMRK reconciliation path, so a future clean window and the owner's chosen 80/20 shadow review
   have contemporaneous evidence. Preparation only, no restart. Small to moderate effort; high decision value because no clean window can start without it. [Readiness](paper-system/observation-readiness/2026-11-02-paper-freeze-readiness.md),
   [shadow brief](programme/verdict-framework/2026-11-10-cross-asset-shadow-decision-brief.md).
2. **Family-adjusted reading of the eleven screens from their stored statistics.** Recompute, from the saved result JSONs only, a Holm or Bonferroni-adjusted p-value across the screens as a descriptive check
   on whether the expected-growth lead (t 2.728) survives trying eight to eleven screens, and state the smallest effect each screen could detect. No new data, no new test, the registered t ≥ 3 bar is unchanged. Small effort. [Category report](programme/research-summary/2026-11-12-strategy-categories-alpha-range.md).
3. **Expected-growth input panel coverage audit (data feasibility, no returns).** Using SEC filings and free sources only, measure how many dated identities, market values and fiscal-period annual facts can be reconstructed per month, how many of the 30 prior monthly fits are reachable, and
   stop and report if rights or timing cannot be verified. Moderate to high effort; the only screen lead with a band above zero in both windows, modest survival odds (t 2.728, cost-sensitive, no Holm). [Pilot](stock-signals/feasibility/2026-11-11-expected-growth-stock-input-pilot.md).
4. **Research-only security-identity validation.** Detect reused tickers, merger-successor series (VMRK carrying EQR, SKYD carrying PSKY, `P`), funds labelled as common stock (the 172 N-2 ticker labels) and class mismatches (`CMU`) from price/volume rows,
   membership dates and independent metadata before any new stock study. Gates idea 3 and any claim based on old delisted prices. Do not repair the closed holdout after seeing results. [Pilot](stock-signals/feasibility/2026-11-11-expected-growth-stock-input-pilot.md),
   [press-release checks](programme/membership-database/2026-11-09-open-checks-closed-with-press-releases.md), [audit](audits/production-replica/2026-10-19-production-replica-audit-nogo.md).
5. **Write the protection-comparison brief once the owner picks its open terms.** The owner chose 80% SPY / 20% Treasury bills; the bill instrument, period boundaries, the "same down years" rule and an acceptable wealth sacrifice remain open. A pre-registered brief (primary measure loss in the same down years, 2027–2029 observation, free bill data) would
   make the comparison prospective rather than hindsight-selected. Small effort once decided. [Draft](programme/verdict-framework/2026-11-10-protection-measures-explained.md).
6. **Actual SSO distribution-character evidence for the owner's A23 review.** Reconcile the fund's distribution tax records (the October 2025 trust-year ordinary-income classification is already found) with the modeled LT/ordinary bounds before treating either endpoint as the investor's experience. Small effort; no entry/exit term changes. [A23 report](allocation/static-leverage/2026-09-30-static-fractional-leverage.md).
7. **Conditional on a candidate meeting Part A:** validate `TaxLotBook` against a hand-built year of real lots, including a wash sale that crosses year-end (working task list A6), and settle WFO fallback semantics (owner decision, A7) before any WFO-based study. [Requirements](paper-system/tax-lots/2026-11-02-after-tax-lot-engine-requirements.md), [semantics](programme/wfo-methods/2026-11-02-wfo-fallback-semantics.md).

**Dropped this run:** forward attribution under the shadow rules as a separate item (folded into idea 1: nothing can be attributed until a clean start exists); another published-portfolio sort of the same large-cap
universe without a new mechanism (eleven tried, none clears both bars, family multiplicity unaddressed); another intraday SPY rule variant (the single r9 score is spent; any variant is a new registered question); earlier drops stand (another core/IC/Kelly/voter optimization, momentum/FOMC
retests, cross-asset trend, A24 timing, post-hoc holdout repair). A fresh
mechanism needs its own brief and data feasibility check. External ideas remain
in [WEB_RESEARCH_CANDIDATES.md](WEB_RESEARCH_CANDIDATES.md), which was not modified (it gained 2026-11-11 analyst-revision data leads, metadata only; no test was run).
